body: 1. Log in. Students log in with a student email ending in .bu.ac.th. The password is the 10-digit student ID.
1.1. Home

1. Top Bar — the top menu lets students jump quickly to other pages or sections of the platform, such as Home, Courses, Schedule, Tasks, and Forum.
2. Class notifications — when a class is about to start, the system notifies the student. Tap 'Join Class' to enter the classroom on time.

1. The side bar lists tasks and activities relevant to the student so they can easily check what needs to be done.
2. Pending Question — shows the student's in-class questions that are still awaiting an answer.
3. Pre-Class Material — this section acts as a guide that walks the learner through pre-class activities in order before each scheduled class.
4. Due Assignment — the system shows assignment deadlines and lets the user jump straight to work that still needs to be completed; by default it navigates to whatever is still unfinished.
5. Submission Bar — shows the total number of tasks still pending, with completed tasks highlighted in orange.

1. The Class Panel lists every class scheduled for today plus upcoming classes for the rest of the current week, Monday through Saturday.
2. The upcoming-class list is sorted by the nearest start time.
3. Each entry shows the time the student needs to attend that class.
4. After clicking the 'Enter Class' button, the student enters the live classroom / Live-Class session.

1. The semester bar is used to pick the semester whose courses the student wants to see.
2. Courses Completion — shows the total number of sessions in a course and the student's progress through it.
3. Course cards — each course card is clickable; clicking one takes the student to that course's detail page.
1. The Class content bar shows the lesson content for a class session so students can view the materials, activities, and assignments tied to that session.

1. Pre-Class tab — lists content or activities students should complete before class begins.
2. In-Class tab — lists content or activities used during the class session.
3. Post-Class tab — lists content or activities students need to complete after class ends.
4. Download button — downloads the content of each sub-unit; only text files and PDFs are supported.
5. Mark as Complete button — students tap this once they've finished a pre-class or post-class activity.

1. AI button — students can tap the AI button to ask questions about the lesson content.
2. AI Chat — students can type to ask about lesson content or to summarize material from past or upcoming weeks (it can't answer about weeks that haven't been released yet).
1. The sub-unit content bar lets students tap to view Pre-Class, In-Class, and Post-Class content, and to do the activities in the session currently being taught.
1. A small screen showing what the instructor is currently presenting; students can tap it to view full-screen.

1. The image content — an illustration on the trivia screen that appears to students while the instructor is on a break from the live broadcast.
2. Did You Know content — short knowledge tidbits shown to students while the instructor pauses the live broadcast.

1. The Submit button sends the answers or information the student has filled in. Once submitted, the system records the student's response. (The student must then tap 'Mark as Complete' to confirm the activity is finished.)
1. Assignment details — shows the assignment's information such as title, release date, due date, score, and number of questions.
1. Poll — displays a poll question so students can pick an answer and submit their response.
1. The Linkage Tools bar shows external tools or links the instructor has prepared for the lesson. Students can click to open the related learning resource or website.

1. Member tab — shows the list of members in the same breakout room as the student.
2. Chat tab — used to send messages within the breakout room during group activities, or to chat with Buddi AI.

1. Group activity bar — students can tap into it to view submission history and the list of group members.
2. View Assignment button — students can tap 'View Assignment' to review and redo the assignment.
3. Group Assignment info bar — shows information about the assigned group work, such as title, due date, description, and submission status.
4. Group activity detail bar — shows the group's submission history and the list of group members.

1. Today's date shows the status of today's class sessions.
2. The info area — when the student hovers over a class entry, the system shows a sub-menu for joining the class.
3. The date range shows which days have classes scheduled.
4. The Week/Month view toggle switches the schedule between weekly and monthly views.

1. Pending Question — shows every in-class question the student has asked that is still awaiting an answer.
2. Due Assignment — the system shows every outstanding assignment deadline.
3. Pre-Class Material — this section shows all recommended pre-class activities for the student to complete.

1. Create Forum — students can create a forum thread by clicking Create and choosing the topic or class related to the question or issue they want to discuss.
2. Forum Filters — used to filter the existing list of threads so students can find relevant ones more easily.
